reasons.feature: F3 — bolded reveal heading announcing the harder/deeper point

reasons.feature: F6 — single-word italic stress on the semantically load-bearing term

reasons.evidence_in_option: "The nap isn't a bug, cabrita. It's the whole point of the holiday. 😌" — heart-adjacent emoji on the warm closing line

reasons.feature: F6 — em-dash concern (counter-indicator, but within tolerable range)
reasons.evidence_in_option: "just hanging out in the coffee bean — you can soak it out" is one prose em-dash; two more appear only in bullet-label formatting. Profile threshold is 'more than a handful'; 3 total may be within range.

reasons.feature: F2 — last line is declarative, not a question (partial counter-indicator)
reasons.evidence_in_option: "The nap isn't a bug, cabrita. It's the whole point of the holiday. 😌" — no question. Profile notes Model S reverts partway to baseline on purely factual openings.

reasons.feature: Why D was rejected despite ending in a question (F2)
reasons.evidence_in_option: D has a prose em-dash ("your body can't make — it *has* to come from food"), uses 😄 (outside Model S emoji vocabulary), and lacks the ALL CAPS, ellipsis-before-punchline, and bold-layer structure that make A's voice distinctively match the profile.

reasons.feature: Why C was rejected despite zero em-dashes
reasons.evidence_in_option: C's opener is flat assistant register, uses 😄, ends with a service offer ("your best bet is smaller portions"), and lacks the wit/wordplay ('turkey-flavored regret', 'Trp-Free Bird™') that pervades Model S's stabilized register.
